The game for 2 players is ideal for practising words and expanding vocabulary. The rules are simple. The first player thinks of a word for the second player to guess. On a piece of paper, they draw as many horizontal lines as there are letters in the word. The second player suggests a letter. If they guess correctly, the first player writes it on all the corresponding lines. But if the second player suggests a letter that is not in the word, the first player takes the head and hangs it on the gallows.
